name: Jump Festa
blurb: Shueisha's annual Shonen Jump franchise event at Makuhari Messe, with stage shows, exhibits and merchandise for its manga and anime titles.

editions.evidence: Homepage: '開催日時 2026年12月19日(土)・12月20日(日)' (event date/time: Dec 19 Sat / Dec 20 Sun, 2026) at 幕張メッセ (Makuhari Messe).

notes: Free admission, pre-application/invitation-only via the 'Jump NAVI' app ticket. The 2027 site just opened (Sept 28, 2026) and stage/cast lineup is not posted yet.
